The vocabulary and sentence length of read literary prose are unlike assistant commands, so a score here does not describe how an engine handles a spoken request. Runs on this corpus are capped at 2,000 clips, drawn with a pinned seed so every fighter is scored on the same ones; a split smaller than the cap is scored in full.
dataset_info.notes: Multilingual LibriSpeech french test split — read audiobook speech. English (mls-en-US) is deliberately not registered here: LibriSpeech-family read speech is already well represented in the arena via other en sets.
